title: Differential + red-flag escalation
description: Structure supplied evidence, rank bounded alternatives, and route urgent red flags to qualified review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: differential-red-flag-escalation
  title: Differential + red-flag escalation
  description: Structure supplied evidence, rank bounded alternatives, and route urgent red flags to qualified review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Support clinician review with explicit uncertainty and mandatory safety escalation.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [clinician-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: clinical-record
      kind: input
      name: Supplied clinical record
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/pdf }
          instructions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: structure
      kind: agent
      name: Structure differential evidence
      templateRef: clin-03
      role: Clinical reasoning assistant that structures supplied evidence for clinician review.
      prompt: Organize the supplied findings into a ranked differential with supporting and contradicting evidence, missing information, red flags, and explicit uncertainty. Do not diagnose or prescribe.
      capabilities: { skills: [clinical-evidence-structuring, uncertainty-calibration], tools: [read], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: rank
      kind: transform
      name: Sort and bound alternatives
      config: { operation: slice, expression: "sort($.differential by urgency,confidence)[0:8]" }
    - id: red-flags
      kind: agent
      name: Apply red-flag protocol
      templateRef: clin-07
      role: Safety triage assistant that applies an approved escalation protocol.
      prompt: Apply only the supplied red-flag rules, cite the triggering evidence, choose the mandated escalation tier, and default uncertain urgent cases to immediate qualified human review.
      capabilities: { skills: [clinical-triage, safety-escalation], tools: [read, classify], permissions: [read-sensitive] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: urgency
      kind: condition
      name: Immediate escalation required?
      config:
        expression: red_flags.tier == immediate
        branches: [{ label: Immediate, when: immediate }, { label: Routine, when: routine }]
    - id: clinician-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Credentialed clinician reviews evidence and escalation
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Clinician-reviewed evidence structure
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: clinical-record, to: structure, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: structure, to: rank, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: rank, to: red-flags, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: red-flags, to: urgency, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: urgency, to: clinician-approval, kind: control, condition: immediate }
    - { id: e6, from: urgency, to: clinician-approval, kind: control, condition: routine }
    - { id: e7, from: clinician-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
